tools.name: get_community_vs_enterprise
tools.description: Return the comparison of the open-source Community Stack and the commercial Enterprise Stack. Read this before writing integration code.

tools.name: get_waltid_doc_page
tools.description: Return the raw markdown for one public docs page. path is a docs path such as /community-stack/issuer2/getting-started.

tools.name: get_waltid_llms_index
tools.description: Return the llms.txt index of public documentation pages. This is the index, not the full text of every page.

tools.name: list_waltid_openapi_specs
tools.description: List public OpenAPI specification URLs from the docs metadata. Returns links only and does not call those APIs.

tools.name: search_waltid_docs
tools.description: Search public walt.id documentation by keyword. Optional stack limits results to concepts, the open-source Community Stack, or the commercial Enterprise Stack. Community and Enterprise searches also include stack-agnostic concepts. Returns titles, paths, and short excerpts.
